title: Shipping Calculator
prompt:
Implement two functions.

1. `double shipping_cost(double weight)`: up to and including 1.0 kg -> 5.00; over 1.0 up to and including 5.0 -> 10.00; above 5.0 -> 10.00 + 1.50 per full kg above 5 (so 6.2 kg -> 11.50).
2. `const char* shipping_label(int speed)` using switch: 1 -> "standard", 2 -> "express", default -> "standard".

tests.name: tier boundaries
tests.hint: Both 'up to and including' edges are inclusive.

tests.name: overage math
tests.hint: Full kg above 5: (int)(weight - 5) when weight > 5. 6.2 -> 1 extra -> 11.50; 7.0 -> 2 extra -> 13.00.
